/* UpsNewbillingMapper.selectManifestToNewbilling : UPS manifestToNewbilling 업데이트 대상 조회 */ SELECT CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), mod.AR_DATE, 111) AS arDate ,mod.LINE_CODE AS lineCode ,mod.VESSEL_FLIGHT AS vesselFlight ,mod.MRN AS mrn ,mod.MSN AS msn ,mod.MBL_NO AS mblNo ,od.CONSIGNEE_NAME_LOC AS consigneeNameLoc ,od.CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS_LOC AS consigneeAddressLoc ,CONCAT(ISNULL(od.CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS, ''), ISNULL(od.CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS_A, ''), ISNULL(od.CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS_B, ''), ISNULL(od.CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS_C, ''), ISNULL(od.CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS_D, '')) AS consigneeAddress ,od.CONSIGNEE_NAME AS consigneeName ,od.HBL_NO AS hblNo ,ISNULL(od.HSN, '') AS hsn ,od.AMOUNT_CUR AS amountCur ,od.PIECES AS pieces ,od.PIECES_REAL AS piecesReal ,od.GWT AS gwt ,od.CD_TYPE AS cdType ,od.ECM_TYPE AS ecmType ,od.ALLOWED_ITEM_CODE AS allowedItemCode ,od.CD_USE_TYPE AS cdUseType ,od.URL AS url ,od.COMMODITY_ITEM AS commodityItem ,od.SHIPPER_COUNTRY_CODE AS shipperCountryCode ,od.ASSIGNMENT_WH_CODE AS assignmentWhCode ,ad.PLAN_YN AS planYn ,ad.LC_NO AS lcNo ,ad.BANK_NAME AS bankName ,ISNULL(ad.TS_SEND_TYPE, '') AS tsSendType ,ISNULL(cdb.CUSTOMS_UPDATE_YN, 'N') AS customsUpdateYn
,dbo.Cryptography(od.OD_JOB_NO, od.CUSTOMS_ID_ENC, 1) AS customsId ,CASE WHEN od.CONSIGNEE_HP_ENC = '' THEN dbo.Cryptography(od.OD_JOB_NO, od.CONSIGNEE_TEL_ENC, 1) ELSE dbo.Cryptography(od.OD_JOB_NO, od.od.CONSIGNEE_HP_ENC, 1) END AS consigneeTel
,od.CUSTOMS_ID AS customsId ,CASE WHEN ISNULL(od.CONSIGNEE_HP, '') = '' THEN od.CONSIGNEE_TEL ELSE od.CONSIGNEE_HP END AS consigneeTel
FROM TB_ECM_OD mod INNER JOIN TB_ECM_OD od ON od.MASTER_OD_JOB_NO = mod.OD_JOB_NO AND od.BL_TYPE_MH = 'H' INNER JOIN TB_ECM_OD_ADDITIONAL ad ON ad.OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO LEFT JOIN TB_CD_B_INFO cdb ON cdb.HBL_NO = od.HBL_NO
WHERE mod.OD_JOB_NO IN(#{item})
AND ad.SIMPLE_DOC_NO IN(#{item})

/* UpsNewbillingMapper.selectManifestToNewbillingCustomsTransfer : UPS manifestToNewbillingCustomsTransfer 업데이트 대상 조회 */ SELECT mod.MRN AS mrn ,mod.MSN AS msn ,od.CONSIGNEE_NAME_LOC AS consigneeNameLoc ,od.CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS_LOC AS consigneeAddressLoc ,od.HBL_NO AS hblNo ,od.CD_USE_TYPE AS cdUseType ,od.HSN AS hsn
,dbo.Cryptography(od.OD_JOB_NO, od.CUSTOMS_ID_ENC, 1) AS customsId
,od.CUSTOMS_ID AS customsId
FROM TB_ECM_OD mod INNER JOIN TB_ECM_OD od ON od.MASTER_OD_JOB_NO = mod.OD_JOB_NO AND od.BL_TYPE_MH = 'H' INNER JOIN TB_ECM_OD_ADDITIONAL ad ON ad.OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO
WHERE od.OD_JOB_NO IN(#{item})
WHERE mod.OD_JOB_NO IN(#{item})
WHERE mod.OD_JOB_NO = #{masterOdJobNo}
AND od.CD_TYPE = 'Y'
AND ISNULL(ad.SIMPLE_DOC_NO, '') IN(#{item})
AND od.CD_TYPE = 'Y' AND ISNULL(ad.SIMPLE_DOC_NO, '') = ''

/* UpsNewbillingMapper.selectLocalNewbillingPCustomsUpdate : UPS LocalNewbillingPCustomsUpdate 업데이트 대상 조회 */ SELECT od.HBL_NO AS hblNo ,od.OD_JOB_NO ,dbo.func_AlphabetRemain(od.CONSIGNEE_NAME) AS CONSIGNEE_NAME_CHK
,RIGHT(dbo.func_getNumeric(dbo.Cryptography(od.OD_JOB_NO, od.CONSIGNEE_HP_ENC, 1)) ,8) AS CONSIGNEE_HP_CHK ,RIGHT(dbo.func_getNumeric(dbo.Cryptography(od.OD_JOB_NO, od.CONSIGNEE_TEL_ENC, 1)) ,8) AS CONSIGNEE_TEL_CHK
,RIGHT(dbo.func_getNumeric(od.CONSIGNEE_HP) ,8) AS CONSIGNEE_HP_CHK ,RIGHT(dbo.func_getNumeric(od.CONSIGNEE_TEL) ,8) AS CONSIGNEE_TEL_CHK
,od.CONSIGNEE_NAME_LOC AS consigneeNameLoc ,od.CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS_LOC AS consigneeAddressLoc ,od.CD_USE_TYPE AS cdUseType ,od.HSN AS hsn ,mod.MRN AS mrn ,mod.MSN as msn FROM TB_ECM_OD mod INNER JOIN TB_ECM_OD od ON od.MASTER_OD_JOB_NO = mod.OD_JOB_NO AND od.BL_TYPE_MH = 'H' WHERE od.MASTER_OD_JOB_NO = #{masterOdJobNo}
AND od.CD_TYPE = 'Y' AND od.CD_USE_TYPE = '1'
AND od.CUSTOMS_ID_ENC = ''
AND ISNULL(od.CUSTOMS_ID, '') = ''

,substring(convert(varchar,dateadd(SECOND,#{excTime},getdate()),120),12,8)
,substring(convert(varchar,getdate(),120),12,8)
,'FMSUSER' ,'' ,'0' ,#{excCode} ,#{excMemo} ,'' )
mapper.update: /* UpsNewbillingMapper.updateSimpleDocNoInfo : 제출번호 초기화 */ UPDATE TB_ECM_OD_ADDITIONAL SET SIMPLE_DOC_NO = NULL, LAST_POD_STATUS = 'ECM100' WHERE OD_JOB_NO = #{odJobNo}
/* UpsNewbillingMapper.updateCustomsIdCdBinfo : 개인통관부호 초기화 */ UPDATE TB_CD_B_INFO SET CUSTOMS_ID = '' WHERE HBL_NO = #{hblNo}
mapper.select: /* UpsNewbillingMapper.selectLocalNewbillingApply : 로컬미결등록 뉴빌링 업데이트 대상건조회 */ SELECT od.HBL_NO AS hblNo ,mod.LINE_CODE AS lineCode ,mod.VESSEL_FLIGHT AS vesselFlight FROM TB_ECM_OD od LEFT JOIN TB_ECM_OD mod ON od.MASTER_OD_JOB_NO = mod.OD_JOB_NO WHERE od.OD_JOB_NO IN (#{item.odJobNo});
mapper.update: /* UpsNewbillingMapper.updateLocalNewbillingApply : 로컬미결등록 뉴빌링 WaybillExceptLog 업데이트 */ UPDATE WaybillExceptLog SET TransferDate = substring(replace(convert(varchar,getdate(),120),'-','/'),1,10) ,Flight = #{flightNo} ,ExcSeq = '0' ,ExcWho = 'PCCC' ,ExHold = 'X' ,ExCode = 'B5' WHERE ShipmentNumber= #{hblNo} IF @@ROWCOUNT = 0 BEGIN INSERT INTO WaybillExceptLog ( TransferDate ,Flight ,ShipmentNumber ,ExcSeq ,ExcEnd ,ExcWho ,ExHold ,ExCode ,TransferMake ) VALUES( substring(replace(convert(varchar,getdate(),120),'-','/'),1,10) ,#{flightNo} ,#{hblNo} ,'0' ,'' ,'PCCC' ,'X' ,'B5' ,substring(replace(convert(varchar,getdate(),120),'-','/'),1,10) ) END
